title: PNG integrity and inventory validation
summary: The dependency-free verifier checks registered PNG contents and finds unsupported or unregistered files.
acceptance_criteria: Reject bad PNG CRC, compressed data, and scanline data even when a manifest hash matches.
Detect uppercase PNG names, nested PNGs, and unregistered root exports.

evidence.claim: Source at the recorded revision implements the described capability.
The public suite ran PNG integrity and inventory regression cases.
